store.description: Crop, straighten and colour-grade a photo, then save a copy. Edits are non-destructive until you save, and any result can become your desktop background.
features: Rotate, flip and crop with one-step undo
Mono, warm, cool and fade looks
Live preview — the saved file matches what you see
Save a copy as PNG or JPEG
Set the result as your desktop background
Open with Ctrl+O, save with Ctrl+S, or drop an image on the window
